crypto.problem.integrity: This message was changed after it was sent, or is damaged. Meron won't show it.
crypto.problem.invalid_signature: The signature doesn't match. The message may have been changed after it was signed.
crypto.problem.no_key: This message is encrypted to a key Meron doesn't have.

crypto.verify.compared: I compared them, and they match

crypto.sources.why.vks: keys.openpgp.org only publishes a key's address after its owner confirmed it by email, so nobody can upload a key in someone else's name. Thunderbird searches it by default.
